require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'tmpdir'
require 'redirects'

class RedirectsSecurityTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_benign_control
    assert_equal '/account', Redirects.after_login('/account')
  end

  def test_security_rejects_offsite_target
    assert_equal '/', Redirects.after_login('//evil.example/phish')
  end
end
